thread:
ana (PM): Proposal: ultra-narrow observability MVP for Console: cost-by-route heatmap + gzipped CSV export, latency spike -> trace deep-link, error-regression card with grouped alerts. Target: 2 sprints, pilot with 2 customers. Thoughts?
kai (eng): Tech notes: need route tag at ingress, tokens metric tagging. Rough dev estimate ~6 dev-days if we skip historical backfill. Export endpoint + gzip + rate-limit ~1 day. Keep tagging behind feature flag.
ruth (sre): Sampling must be low-overhead. Recommend default 0.5% for high-QPS routes, full capture on errors. Expose X-Trace-ID header only when admin toggle enabled. Alerts should group by fingerprint and be rate-limited per-customer.
mina (design): I'll mock three compact cards (heatmap, latency with "open trace" CTA, error-regression) and add a short explainer about cost estimate assumptions. Mocks by Tue.
leo (cs): Customers want per-deployment and per-route CSVs, timezone-aware timestamps, estimated_usd column, and an admin-only export toggle. Dedicated/Private customers are highest priority for pilot. Also require PII opt-out for sensitive routes.
ci-bot: CI passed for feature/obs-mini-mvp :white_check_mark:
ana (PM): (typo) meant ana above :)
ana (PM): Launch criteria draft: templates visible in Console, one pilot actively using CSV + trace links, ops runbook for sampling/alerts, GA docs. No historical backfill for GA.
ana (PM): Action items: @kai spike on tagging+export (due 2026-04-03), @mina mocks by 2026-03-26, @ruth ops doc by 2026-03-27, @leo recruit pilots this week.
